# lamejs MP3 encoder

`lame.min.js` is a separately loaded, unmodified distribution of lamejs 1.2.1.

Source and replacement builds: https://github.com/zhuker/lamejs
LAME project: https://lame.sourceforge.io/
License: GNU Lesser General Public License 2.1; see LICENSE-LGPL-2.1.txt.

The application loads this standalone library for MP3 export in a worker. You can replace the library without changing the app. The application does not modify LAME/lamejs.
